info.title: API.SH: Walmart
info.description: The Walmart API from API.SH: public Walmart data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Walmart's own search suggestions for a prefix (queries, with images and links where Walmart has them).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/walmart-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products of a Walmart browse (category) page, about 40 per page, with the same product fields as /walmart/v1/search, plus breadcrumbs, filters and sort options. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/walmart-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Walmart category id (cat_id), e.g. 3944_1060825 (TV & Home Theater).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A www.walmart.com/browse/… URL, instead of id.

parameters.name: facet
parameters.description: Raw Walmart facet string (name:value pairs joined with ||).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Walmart product: name, brand, price and was price, rating and reviews, specifications, images, variants and category path, plus its offers by condition (`offers`), other sellers (`other_sellers`), offer counts, the selling seller (`seller_info`: name, type, rating, reviews), shipping options with delivery dates and cost (`shipping_options`), the delivery messages shown (`fulfillment_messages`), store pickup (`pickup`) and the return policy.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/walmart-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: best_match (default), price_low, price_high, best_seller, rating_high, new.

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: walmart (sold by Walmart) or marketplace (third-party sellers).

parameters.name: facet
parameters.description: Raw Walmart facet string as in walmart.com search URLs (name:value pairs joined with ||), combined with the filters above.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Walmart Marketplace seller's public profile: display and legal name, seller type and status, badge, logo and banner, the business address and contact Walmart shows on the seller page, and the seller rating summary (average and count).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/walmart-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The seller id in walmart.com/seller/<id> (`catalog_seller_id` in search results).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The seller page URL instead of `id`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
